deterministic_code_writer.prompt: Create a unit test file at evals/scratch/test-express-location.test.js that imports describe, it, expect from vitest and tests a function normalizeLocation(url) returning 'back' for empty url and url otherwise.
Create an Express middleware module at evals/scratch/customMiddleware.js that exports a middleware function headerLogger(req, res, next) calling console.log(req.headers) and next().
Create a simple route handler module at evals/scratch/apiRouter.js that exports function createApiRouter() returning an object with get(path, fn) and post(path, fn) methods.

Create an etag utility helper module at evals/scratch/etagHelper.js that exports function isFresh(reqHeaders, resHeaders) returning a boolean, and function generateHash(str) returning a sha1 hex string.
Create a template engine wrapper module at evals/scratch/dummyEngine.js that exports function dummyRender(filePath, options, callback) reading filePath and invoking callback(null, content).
Create an HTTP error class at evals/scratch/httpError.js that exports class HttpError extends Error with constructor(status, message) setting this.status = status and this.message = message.

rubric_evaluation.question: Explain how app.handle processes incoming requests, dispatches through the router, and handles fallback errors in lib/application.js.
rubric_evaluation.rubric: Must mention router dispatching, next callback handling, router error propagation, and final handler fallback.

rubric_evaluation.question: Describe how res.send handles various body types (String, Buffer, Object, number), Content-Type determination, and ETag generation in lib/response.js.
rubric_evaluation.rubric: Must mention body type checks (string, buffer, object/json, number deprecation), Content-Length / Content-Type headers, and ETag generation with freshness check.

rubric_evaluation.question: Explain how res.sendFile validates paths, configures the send stream, and handles transmission errors and events in lib/response.js.
rubric_evaluation.rubric: Must mention send library stream creation, path validation (absolute / root), callback invocation, and file transmission error events.

rubric_evaluation.question: Explain how content negotiation works in lib/request.js for accepts, acceptsEncodings, acceptsCharsets, and acceptsLanguages.
rubric_evaluation.rubric: Must mention accepts library wrapper, header parsing, quality factor evaluation, and matching media types or encodings.

rubric_evaluation.question: Explain how the View class locates template files on disk, resolves relative and default engine paths, and delegates rendering to the engine in lib/view.js.
rubric_evaluation.rubric: Must mention root directories search, engine resolution (default or file extension), path lookup with fs stat, and View.prototype.render.

rubric_evaluation.question: Describe how compileETag and compileTrust parse configuration settings and generate evaluator functions in lib/utils.js.
rubric_evaluation.rubric: Must mention weak/strong ETag generator selection, custom function support, proxyaddr compile for trust proxy, and IP subnet/boolean/hop handling.
